name: Slab-based Raycasting
definition: A raycasting technique that caches sampled voxels in shared memory as slabs to improve performance when volume data is accessed multiple times, such as for gradient calculation in Phong lighting.
summary: Slab-based raycasting is a CUDA optimization that caches voxels in shared memory to accelerate gradient calculations, trading reduced early termination granularity for improved performance on high-resolution, semi-transparent data.
